sources.beginner: crude density hand-calc except an unstated 15.56 C reference; the other five need the water viscosity/density fits whose constants no lesson prints; panels (WaterExplorer.jsx) run only the teaching stream; Suite Produced Water Treatment studio unnamed and prints 1-3 dp
sources.intermediate: turndown, shear penalty and bed cut are exact hand-calcs from intermediate m03/m05; cyclone cut, bubble rise and holdup need the undisclosed fluid fits (DeviceExplorer.jsx runs KOKORI only)
sources.advanced: all six need the undisclosed fluid fits plus a 60-bin train integration; TrainExplorer.jsx runs only the teaching train

fields.recommendation: Ungradable as posed: nothing a learner can reach evaluates the capstone stream at the stated precision. fields.evidence: The water viscosity fit, fresh water density fit and salinity term are 'declared constants' the lessons never print (beginner m02 l01:30, l03:22), so no hand route exists.
